Notes

The reference month is 3 months prior to the interview. For example, if the interview took place on March 15, the reference month would be December. Questions about eldercare were introduced in January 2011. Therefore, cases with [TUYEAR < 2011] will have missing values for TUELDER. Files: Respondent File (the dictionary's File column).
